Subject: Subprocessor enumeration + CAIQ highlights for SOC2 review

Hi Evelyn,

As part of our vendor SOC2 intake, our security team needs a complete enumeration of Redwood's subprocessors (current at time of request) plus a mapping to control ownership for the services that process PHI/PII. Specifically we need: 1) a CSV with vendor name, primary purpose, country, data categories processed, and encryption at-rest/in-transit status; 2) a short control ownership spreadsheet (who owns access control, logging, retention for each integration); and 3) a pointer to your latest SOC2 report and any CAIQ/SIG that you maintain.

Two questions for triage: we saw references to a "KV cache provider" and an "analytics telemetry vendor" in your prior documentation — can you confirm which external partners are involved in caching and telemetry (we need retention periods and whether they have access to unredacted user content)?

Can you provide the CSV and the control-ownership sheet by EOD Friday (Sep 5)? If you prefer, a redacted export is acceptable for now and we can request full records under NDA.

Thanks,
Jane
Security Program Manager
Acadia Therapeutics
